coffee.title: Coffee Photo Tips
coffee.tip1: Focus on the underside of the leaf where rust pustules and leaf miners appear.
coffee.tip2: Avoid harsh direct sunlight; cast a gentle shadow with your body if needed.
coffee.tip3: Hold the leaf 15–20 cm away, sharply focused and steady.

cacao.title: Cacao Photo Tips
cacao.tip1: Photograph the entire pod or the visible frosty pod / black pod lesion.
cacao.tip2: Ensure the pod fills most of the frame.
cacao.tip3: Wipe the phone lens clean to avoid moisture blur in humid fields.

banana.title: Banana Photo Tips
banana.tip1: Capture the streaks and spots along the leaf veins.
banana.tip2: Frame the transition zone between healthy tissue and sigatoka lesions.
banana.tip3: Hold the leaf steady against the wind before shooting.

result.title: Diagnosis Result
result.lowConfidenceAdvice: The image lacks sharpness or framing for reliable classification. Please retake closer to the leaf with good lighting.
result.adviceHealthy: Maintain standard agronomic practices and continue periodic plot monitoring.
result.adviceWatch: Increase inspection frequency and evaluate symptom dispersion on neighboring plants.
result.adviceActNow: Consult official extension service guides or a certified agronomist immediately before applying treatments.
